proposals.action_title: Launch 5 Niche Coloring Books on Amazon KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: Coloring books have a proven transactional intent on Amazon. Utilizing the existing 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline with the Runware PAYG FLUX-schnell API (highly affordable at ~20€ budget) bypasses the current image generation blocker to deliver high-quality, sellable interiors immediately.
proposals.first_action_today: Configure Runware API key in GitHub Actions secrets and run 'produce_coloring_book' for a specific high-intent niche (e.g., 'Cozy Hygge Life Coloring Book').

proposals.action_title: Bulk Upload 100 Sticker Designs on Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble is already registered. Stickers are low-cost impulse buys that require minimal formatting. Generating transparent PNG designs using the 'produce_literal_idioms' or 'produce_svg_pack' pipeline leverages native search traffic without active ad spend.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 20 transparent PNG sticker designs using Together AI (FLUX-schnell via GitHub Actions) and upload them to Redbubble using their batch uploader.

proposals.action_title: Launch 3 Parametric Functional 3D Models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is highly receptive to functional, parametric 3D prints (e.g., custom organizers, gridfinity accessories, or replacement parts). The 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline can generate these programmatically with zero manual CAD labor.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 3 STL variations of a modular desk organizer using OpenSCAD/Python scripts on Termux and create the Cults3D listings priced at 1.99€.

proposals.action_title: Introductory Pricing Strategy for New KDP Book Releases
proposals.why_this_works_now: An unreviewed book priced at $7.99 struggles to convert. Pricing the initial coloring books at the absolute minimum royalty floor ($4.99) for the first 14 days triggers early algorithmic sales velocity and reviews, before raising to standard pricing ($7.99).
proposals.first_action_today: Set the retail price of the first generated coloring book to $4.99 upon submission to KDP.

proposals.action_title: Publish 3 Game Dev Asset Packs on itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly buy 2D UI elements, pixel art assets, or seamless textures for game jams. Using the 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' pipeline, Hugo can package generated visual elements into zip folders and list them as paid assets (with a small free sample tier to drive traffic).
proposals.first_action_today: Package 50 seamless game textures generated via Together AI into a zip file, create an itch.io creator account, and publish the pack for $2.99.

proposals.action_title: Redbubble Title and Tag Optimization Sweep
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble relies heavily on precise tag matching. Using a standardized metadata format (15 highly relevant, low-competition tags, clear descriptive title, no spam) for all uploaded stickers maximizes organic search impressions from day one.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a quick Python parser script in Termux that generates 15 optimized tags and a clean title based on the design's target niche keywords before uploading.
